name: CO2 Impact
summary: UK carbon reporting software for small and mid-sized businesses: emissions from bills and uploads across Scope 1, 2 and 3, a carbon reduction plan, SECR reports and optional automated meter data.
best_for: UK small and mid-sized businesses that need a first carbon footprint, Scope 1-3 reporting or a carbon reduction plan for customers and tenders, without hiring a consultant
skip_if: you want to try the software before committing for a year, you need multi-country group reporting, or you already work with a sustainability consultancy that supplies its own tools
honest_knock: Every licence is a 12-month commitment, and automated electricity and gas data is billed extra per meter per year. The public table does not show in text which plan includes advanced or SECR reports. A separate /pricing page on the site still shows placeholder dollar plans and lorem-ipsum text, so use the table on the homepage. No free trial is mentioned. We have not used CO2 Impact ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per year (£39/mo) for 1 user and 1 site
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-09 in a browser render of the pricing table on co2impact.co.uk's homepage, GBP, all prices exclude VAT) Every licence has a 12-month commitment, with an option to pay monthly. Basic is £468 a year (£39.00 a month) for 1 user and 1 operational site. Professional is £599 a year (£49.92 a month) for 3 users and 3 sites. Premium is £729 a year (£60.75 a month) for 5 users and 5 sites. Platinum is £1,199 a year (£99.92 a month) for 10 users and 10 sites. On every plan an additional user costs £60 a year and an additional site £80 a year, and consultancy support is £75 an hour. Automated meter data is an add-on priced per meter per year and gets cheaper on bigger plans: electricity £36, £33, £30 and £24, gas £15.60, £14.40, £13.20 and £12 (Basic to Platinum). The table lists Scope 1 and 2, all 15 Scope 3 categories, a mobile data-collection app, a carbon reduction plan, standard and advanced reports, SECR reporting, an AI data check, bill uploads and Excel/CSV bulk uploads, but the plain-text render does not show which of these each plan includes. The toggle says paying annually saves up to 20%, yet the page shows no higher monthly price. No free trial or free plan is mentioned. A separate /pricing page on the same site shows placeholder dollar plans ($9, $19, $49 with 'API access') and lorem-ipsum text; it is a template leftover, not the real price list.

cost_traps.label: Key features are paid add-ons
cost_traps.evidence: Automated meter data is an add-on priced per meter per year and gets cheaper on bigger plans: electricity £36, £33, £30 and £24, gas £15.60, £14.40, £13.20 and £12 (Basic to Platinum).

compare_with.name: a carbon consultancy
compare_with.why: a consultancy delivers the footprint and reduction plan for you at day rates; CO2 Impact is software you fill yourself from bills and uploads, at a fixed yearly price per user and site, with consultancy at £75 an hour if you need help
